description: Reviewed privacy, retention, publication, and provider-provenance policy for every telemetry v0.1 JSON Schema property.

provenanceStatuses.observed: Read from provider-owned local telemetry or a provider status response.
provenanceStatuses.derived: Deterministically computed from observed or declared source metadata.
provenanceStatuses.declared: Supplied explicitly by the participant or collector configuration.
provenanceStatuses.heuristic: Inferred with uncertainty from indirect evidence.
provenanceStatuses.mixed: The field may combine observed, derived, declared, or heuristic inputs.
provenanceStatuses.unavailable: The current adapter does not reliably supply this field.
provenanceStatuses.not_applicable: The field describes the export protocol rather than provider telemetry.

policyGroups.purpose: Pins the record to an explicit telemetry contract version.
policyGroups.limitation: Version identifies shape, not semantic compatibility with later contracts.

policyGroups.purpose: Places a participant-declared activity marker on the UTC timeline.
policyGroups.limitation: Marker time can differ from the actual start or end of activity.

policyGroups.purpose: Names the product surface associated with manually marked activity.
policyGroups.limitation: The participant can choose an incorrect or overly broad surface.

policyGroups.purpose: Distinguishes activity interval starts, ends, and point observations.
policyGroups.limitation: Unpaired start or end markers do not define a complete interval.

policyGroups.purpose: Records the expected relationship between a surface and the shared agentic allowance.
policyGroups.limitation: Product accounting rules can change and this classification is not provider attestation.

policyGroups.purpose: Groups observations by the participant's subscription plan family.
policyGroups.limitation: Plan may be declared, locally observed, stale, or unknown.

policyGroups.purpose: Groups quota observations by the participant's subscription plan family.
policyGroups.limitation: Plan may be locally observed, stale, or unknown; no Claude telemetry adapter emits this record yet.

policyGroups.purpose: Separates known allowance multipliers or promotions within a plan family.
policyGroups.limitation: Variants are participant-supplied and may not match provider-side entitlements.

policyGroups.purpose: Separates known allowance variants within a quota plan family.
policyGroups.limitation: Variants are participant-supplied and Claude telemetry export is not implemented.

policyGroups.purpose: Supports deterministic deduplication or integrity linkage without source identifiers.
policyGroups.limitation: Determinism and collision scope depend on the documented identity subject and secret.

policyGroups.purpose: Deduplicates one physical quota observation without exporting its source identifier.
policyGroups.limitation: The v2 source-occurrence locator is implemented only for Codex rollout records and changes with identity-secret rotation.

policyGroups.purpose: Compares repeated observations of the same provider quota state without conflating them with observation identity.
policyGroups.limitation: Unattributed state is session-scoped and intentionally cannot collapse across unknown accounts.

policyGroups.purpose: Deduplicates one physical usage occurrence without exporting its source identifier.
policyGroups.limitation: The v2 source-occurrence locator is implemented only for Codex rollout records and changes with identity-secret rotation.

policyGroups.purpose: Links declared activity for one local account without exporting the provider account identifier.
policyGroups.limitation: Unattributed markers cannot be split safely, and secret rotation breaks linkage.

policyGroups.purpose: Links records for one local account without exporting the provider account identifier.
policyGroups.limitation: Unattributed historical records cannot be split safely, secret rotation breaks linkage, and Claude export is not implemented.

policyGroups.purpose: Identifies the exporter implementation that produced the bundle.
policyGroups.limitation: Implementation version alone does not prove configuration or binary integrity.

policyGroups.purpose: Links uploads from one installation using a secret-backed pseudonym.
policyGroups.limitation: It is linkable within the dataset and changes if the participant secret is lost or rotated.

policyGroups.purpose: Records when the local export artifact was created.
policyGroups.limitation: Uses the local system clock and does not prove upload time.

policyGroups.purpose: Contains the inclusive time bounds represented by the artifact.
policyGroups.limitation: Bounds do not imply continuous observation or complete coverage.

policyGroups.purpose: Records the earliest time included by the artifact.
policyGroups.limitation: Earliest included record may postdate the actual observation start.

policyGroups.purpose: Records the latest time included by the artifact.
policyGroups.limitation: Latest included record may predate export creation or actual observation end.

policyGroups.purpose: Pins the local review and consent language applied to the bundle.
policyGroups.limitation: A version label is not by itself proof of informed consent.

policyGroups.purpose: Declares which provider adapters contributed records to the bundle.
policyGroups.limitation: Presence names an adapter, not completeness of its source telemetry.

policyGroups.purpose: Supports platform-specific data-quality and exporter compatibility analysis.
policyGroups.limitation: Coarse platform does not identify exact OS version or collection environment.

policyGroups.purpose: Makes the local-only transport safety gate explicit.
policyGroups.limitation: A false value prevents intended upload but cannot stop unrelated software from copying a file.

policyGroups.purpose: Groups per-record-family counts for reconciliation.
policyGroups.limitation: Counts show exported records, not provider-side total activity.

policyGroups.purpose: Reports the number of exported usage events.
policyGroups.limitation: Deduplication and adapter gaps can make the count differ from provider activity.

policyGroups.purpose: Reports the number of exported quota observations.
policyGroups.limitation: Repeated provider states and polling cadence affect this count.

policyGroups.purpose: Reports the number of exported participant activity markers.
policyGroups.limitation: Marker count reflects participant behavior and is not automatic coverage.

policyGroups.purpose: Contains the privacy-minimized telemetry record families.
policyGroups.limitation: Container safety depends on every referenced record schema and exporter check.

policyGroups.purpose: Carries token, tier, surface, tool-class, and outcome observations.
policyGroups.limitation: Provider adapters expose different components and confidence levels.

policyGroups.purpose: Carries observed remaining-allowance state over time.
policyGroups.limitation: Snapshot precision and availability are provider-controlled.

policyGroups.purpose: Carries participant-declared cross-surface activity annotations.
policyGroups.limitation: Manual annotations are incomplete and may be inaccurate.

policyGroups.purpose: Contains bounded collection and normalization quality signals.
policyGroups.limitation: Only recognized diagnostic classes are retained; details and content are excluded.

policyGroups.purpose: Reports how many local source files were examined.
policyGroups.limitation: File count does not reveal byte coverage, validity, or missing files.

policyGroups.purpose: Groups bounded diagnostic counters without source text.
policyGroups.limitation: Counters intentionally omit file names, lines, and error content.

policyGroups.purpose: Names an allowlisted collection or normalization condition.
policyGroups.limitation: The bounded code cannot explain the specific source record or root cause.

policyGroups.purpose: Counts occurrences of one allowlisted diagnostic condition.
policyGroups.limitation: One source event can contribute to more than one diagnostic counter.

policyGroups.purpose: Binds the receipt to the exact serialized bundle bytes.
policyGroups.limitation: Hash proves byte equality, not truth or completeness of the source data.

policyGroups.purpose: Records the hashed bundle byte length for integrity checks.
policyGroups.limitation: Size can weakly correlate with activity volume and is not a completeness measure.

policyGroups.purpose: Summarizes whether all local privacy checks passed.
policyGroups.limitation: Passing covers implemented checks only and is not a general privacy proof.

policyGroups.purpose: Lists bounded local privacy validations applied to the bundle.
policyGroups.limitation: Checks cannot detect sensitive meaning encoded into an otherwise permitted value.

policyGroups.purpose: Names a local privacy validation.
policyGroups.limitation: Meaning depends on the exporter version implementing the check.

policyGroups.purpose: Reports whether one privacy validation passed.
policyGroups.limitation: Status is only as reliable as the validation implementation.

policyGroups.purpose: Counts violations found by one privacy validation.
policyGroups.limitation: Count omits offending values intentionally and can combine distinct causes.

policyGroups.purpose: Declares sensitive source categories that the exporter excludes.
policyGroups.limitation: Declaration describes design intent; receipt checks provide bounded enforcement evidence.

policyGroups.purpose: Places the provider quota state on the UTC observation timeline.
policyGroups.limitation: Provider timestamp semantics and local clock skew can differ by source; Claude export is not implemented.

policyGroups.purpose: Records when the local client received or logged the quota observation.
policyGroups.limitation: The rollout exporter currently copies observedTime because no independent receipt timestamp is retained.

policyGroups.purpose: Identifies the provider adapter responsible for record semantics.
policyGroups.limitation: Provider label does not identify an account, endpoint, or billing entity; no Claude telemetry adapter emits this schema yet.

policyGroups.purpose: Names the provider limit or model-specific allowance being observed.
policyGroups.limitation: Provider identifiers may be absent, renamed, or mapped to unknown; Claude export is not implemented.

policyGroups.purpose: Maps the observation to a rolling or weekly quota window.
policyGroups.limitation: Primary and secondary labels require duration evidence before interpretation; Claude export is not implemented.

policyGroups.purpose: Records provider-reported quota consumption as a percentage.
policyGroups.limitation: Provider rounding obscures smaller changes and percentage need not be linear in API cost; Claude export is not implemented.

policyGroups.purpose: Records the known decimal precision of the displayed usage percentage.
policyGroups.limitation: The current parser reconstructs precision after JSON number parsing, so trailing zero precision is lost.

policyGroups.purpose: Records the nominal duration of the quota window.
policyGroups.limitation: Nominal duration does not prove whether the implementation is fixed, rolling, or reset-based; Claude export is not implemented.

policyGroups.purpose: Records the provider-reported quota reset time.
policyGroups.limitation: Reported reset time can be approximate and propagation may be delayed.

policyGroups.purpose: Identifies how the quota snapshot was collected.
policyGroups.limitation: Collection source affects timing and precision but not necessarily provider accounting semantics.

policyGroups.purpose: Classifies whether the limit is shared, general, model-specific, or separate.
policyGroups.limitation: Classification is based on available product evidence and may change over time.

policyGroups.purpose: Links related local records without exporting the raw provider session identifier.
policyGroups.limitation: Session boundaries vary by provider and client, and secret rotation breaks linkage.

policyGroups.purpose: Places a usage event on the UTC cost and quota timeline.
policyGroups.limitation: Timestamp may represent logging or completion rather than provider billing time.

policyGroups.purpose: Names a reviewed model identifier when it is safe to retain verbatim.
policyGroups.limitation: Unreviewed names are replaced by unknown and a keyed fingerprint; aliases can still obscure equivalence.

policyGroups.purpose: Groups unreviewed model strings without disclosing their literal value.
policyGroups.limitation: Fingerprint is installation-specific and cannot be joined after secret rotation.

policyGroups.purpose: Distinguishes reviewed models, unrecognized raw model strings, and absent model evidence.
policyGroups.limitation: Recognition is relative to the reviewed registry version used by the exporter.

policyGroups.purpose: Separates subscription allowance usage from metered API usage.
policyGroups.limitation: Local source location may not reveal the provider's ultimate billing route.

policyGroups.purpose: Records standard versus accelerated product execution mode.
policyGroups.limitation: Historical logs may omit speed mode and provider multipliers can change.

policyGroups.purpose: Records the standard, priority, flex, or batch API execution tier.
policyGroups.limitation: Product speed mode and API pricing tier are distinct and logs can omit both.

policyGroups.purpose: Records the configured reasoning-effort category for cost stratification.
policyGroups.limitation: The current exporter emits unknown because no authoritative effort field is mapped.

policyGroups.purpose: Contains mutually interpretable token accounting components.
policyGroups.limitation: Provider token taxonomies differ, missing components remain null, and no Claude usage exporter exists yet.

policyGroups.purpose: Records input tokens not served from a provider cache.
policyGroups.limitation: Codex uncached input is derived by subtraction; missing or internally inconsistent source components produce null.

policyGroups.purpose: Records input tokens served from a provider cache.
policyGroups.limitation: Cache semantics, duration, and billing multipliers differ by provider.

policyGroups.purpose: Records tokens written into a provider prompt cache.
policyGroups.limitation: Current Codex export can preserve an observed cache-write component when present, but historical absence remains null; Claude export is not implemented.

policyGroups.purpose: Records non-reasoning output tokens used for API-price estimation.
policyGroups.limitation: Codex text output is derived when total and reasoning counts are both available.

policyGroups.purpose: Records separately reported hidden reasoning output tokens.
policyGroups.limitation: Missing source evidence is exported as null; a numeric zero is emitted only when the source component was present.

policyGroups.purpose: Retains the full input-context total for independent component reconciliation.
policyGroups.limitation: Total may be cumulative or differently defined across provider log formats.

policyGroups.purpose: Classifies the local product or execution surface producing usage.
policyGroups.limitation: Ambiguous local evidence is intentionally mapped to an unclassified category.

policyGroups.purpose: Separates root, subagent, automation, and unknown agent execution.
policyGroups.limitation: Nested agents may not emit independently attributable usage records.

policyGroups.purpose: Distinguishes standalone, forked, and parent-linked session lineage.
policyGroups.limitation: Missing parents and replayed history can make lineage incomplete.

policyGroups.purpose: Contains privacy-safe counts of broad tool mechanism classes.
policyGroups.limitation: Tool names, arguments, results, and billing units are excluded; attribution can be incomplete.

policyGroups.purpose: Counts invocations assigned to one broad, allowlisted tool class.
policyGroups.limitation: Counts do not measure tool duration, arguments, provider billing, or semantic work.

policyGroups.purpose: Classifies whether the associated work completed, failed, stopped, or retried.
policyGroups.limitation: The current exporter emits unknown because no authoritative task-outcome mapping is implemented.
